protection_map.title: Protection map
protection_map.lead: A whole-portfolio view of documented terms, neutral unknowns and sourced compulsory alerts.
protection_map.event_notice: Life events are self-authored prompts. They do not establish policy values or change evidence classes.
protection_map.scenario_notice: No overlap amount is shown until you enter a scenario estimate.

tour.done: That's the tour. Everything you saw is live.

household.members_body: Members, assets and businesses come from the documents that were uploaded. Nothing here is typed in by the product.
household.card_title: One plan layout for every policy
household.card_body: Health, motor, home and travel all use the same seven sections. A value with no document behind it shows no number and names the document that would establish it.
household.evidence_title: The exact wording behind a value
household.evidence_body: Each value opens the sentence it came from, with its page. The badge says who wrote that document, which decides how far it can be relied on.
household.alert_body: An alert appears only when its statute entry is source-quoted or human-verified. A penalty is shown only when its current primary text has been verified.
household.map_title: The whole household on one map
household.map_body: Members and assets against risks. Not found in the documents read is never shown as not covered, and not assessed stays grey.
household.ask_title: Ask a question about the policies
household.ask_body: Answers cite their clause. When the documents cannot answer, VERIS says which document would.
household.claims_title: A claim that stops for your OK
household.claims_body: The agent prepares the checklist, the deadline and the packet. Anything with an external effect waits for your confirmation and a password re-entry.
household.reset_body: The demo reset removes only the synthetic example from this account. Your own uploads are never removed here.

demo_reset.title: Reset the synthetic example
demo_reset.body: Removes the synthetic household, its generated documents and its claims from this account so the example can be loaded again. Nothing you uploaded yourself is removed.
demo_reset.confirm_body: Only records the server stamped as the synthetic example are removed, with the example's claims. Documents and photos you uploaded, including any attached to an example claim, are kept; only the step-up privacy erase removes them. The agent ledger keeps its history.
demo_reset.done: Example reset: {policies} policies and {documents} documents removed.

upload.camera_label: Take a photo of a document
upload.camera_notice: The photo becomes a one-page PDF in this browser and its location data is dropped. It then passes the same upload checks as any PDF: this build reads a document's own text layer, so a photographed page is reported as unreadable rather than guessed at. Photos are never sent to an AI provider.
upload.camera_converted: Photo, converted to a one-page PDF in this browser
upload.camera_failed: The photo could not be converted. Try again, or upload a PDF.
upload.camera_unsupported: This browser cannot convert a photo here. Upload a PDF instead.

offline.title: VERIS is offline
